+import asyncio
+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, Security
+from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, SecurityScopes
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+security = HTTPBearer()
+
+async def dep_no_scopes():
+    return "no_scopes"
+
+async def dep_with_scopes(scopes: SecurityScopes):
+    return f"scopes: {scopes.scopes}"
+
+async def top_level_1(dep=Depends(dep_no_scopes)):
+    return dep
+
+async def top_level_2(dep=Depends(dep_no_scopes)):
+    return dep
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+@app.get("/test1")
+async def test1(dep=Depends(top_level_1)):
+    return dep
+
+@app.get("/test2")
+async def test2(dep=Depends(top_level_2)):
+    return dep
+
+# To test caching, we need to track calls to dep_no_scopes
+call_count = 0
+async def dep_no_scopes_tracked():
+    global call_count
+    call_count += 1
+    return "no_scopes"
+
+async def top_level_1_tracked(dep=Depends(dep_no_scopes_tracked)):
+    return dep
+
+async def top_level_2_tracked(dep=Depends(dep_no_scopes_tracked)):
+    return dep
+
+@app.get("/test3")
+async def test3(dep=Depends(top_level_1_tracked)):
+    return dep
+
+@app.get("/test4")
+async def test4(dep=Depends(top_level_2_tracked)):
+    return dep
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_caching():
+    global call_count
+    call_count = 0
+    
+    # First request
+    client.get("/test3")
+    count1 = call_count
+    
+    # Second request to same endpoint
+    client.get("/test3")
+    count2 = call_count
+    
+    # Third request to different endpoint that uses same dependency
+    client.get("/test4")
+    count3 = call_count
+    
+    print(f"Call count: {count1}, {count2}, {count3}")
+    # count1 should be 1
+    # count2 should be 1 (cached)
+    # count3 should be 1 (cached across different top-level deps)
+    assert count1 == 1
+    assert count2 == 1
+    assert count3 == 1
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_caching()
